elements.title: Henri Claireaux (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that in 1959, Henri Claireaux claimed that a reduction to a subsidy to Saint Pierre and Miquelon had devolved the territory into "a state bordering on poverty"?

elements.title: sanewashing (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that both Tim Walz and JD Vance were accused of sanewashing in the 2024 vice presidential debate?

elements.title: Kazimierz Sakowicz (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Kazimierz Sakowicz spent three years recording the murder of tens of thousands in his diary, which was published decades later?

elements.title: Rust Red Hills (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Rust Red Hills is being sold to renovate student housing, a court-approved move that museum associations say violates the ethics of deaccessioning?

elements.title: Amaury du Closel (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Amaury du Closel founded the Forum Voix Etouffées to revive music that was suppressed by 20th-century totalitarian regimes?

elements.title: Welsh university students in 1900 (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that 38 per cent of Welsh university students in 1900 were women?

elements.title: Johnny Fripp (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Johnny Fripp was described as "a bundle of football-toting dynamite"?

elements.title: Big Motor (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Big Motor employees hit cars with socks stuffed with golf balls as part of an insurance-fraud scheme?
